title: Entity mapping center
description: Review supplier external identities against canonical football entities. Unconfirmed mappings never write canonical data.

statisticsExecution.title: Execute supplier statistic candidate
statisticsExecution.warning: This replaces formal team and player statistics with complete candidate snapshots and publishes a new match revision. The whole operation is rejected when any entity or statistic type mapping is missing.
statisticsExecution.reasonRequired: The operation reason must contain at least 3 characters
statisticsExecution.failed: Execution failed. Check candidate completeness, mappings, and revisions.

standingExecution.title: Execute supplier standing candidate
standingExecution.warning: This publishes the complete candidate set from the same collection run and season/stage/group scope as the formal current standing. Any missing scope, team mapping, or core detail rejects the whole snapshot.
standingExecution.reasonRequired: The reason must contain at least 3 characters
standingExecution.failed: Execution failed; check collection evidence, completeness, mappings, and revisions

commentaryExecution.title: Execute supplier commentary candidate
commentaryExecution.warning: This creates or revises formal English commentary and publishes a new match revision. Missing match or player mappings and missing raw evidence reject the operation.
commentaryExecution.reasonRequired: The reason must contain at least 3 characters
commentaryExecution.failed: Execution failed; check raw evidence, entity mappings, text hash, and revisions

eventExecution.title: Execute supplier event candidates
eventExecution.warning: Ordinary events are applied atomically in one match revision. VAR without an explicit reviewed event is deferred and never auto-linked or allowed to alter scores.
eventExecution.overrides: Manual VAR override JSON keyed by provider event ID
eventExecution.reasonRequired: The reason must contain at least 3 characters
eventExecution.invalidOverrides: VAR overrides must be a valid JSON object
eventExecution.failed: Execution failed; check raw evidence, entity/type mappings, scores, and revisions

lineupExecution.title: Execute supplier lineup candidates
lineupExecution.warning: Both team lineups are published atomically. Missing team, player, role, or position mappings reject the whole batch.
lineupExecution.reasonRequired: The reason must contain at least 3 characters
lineupExecution.failed: Execution failed; check raw evidence, confirmation status, entity/dictionary mappings, and revisions

scoreStatusExecution.title: Execute supplier status and score candidate
scoreStatusExecution.warning: State and all scores are published as one atomic batch. State, score type, and home/away mappings must be complete; canonical data is never overwritten automatically.
scoreStatusExecution.confirmScores: Confirm these scores as final trusted scores
scoreStatusExecution.reasonRequired: The reason must contain at least 3 characters
scoreStatusExecution.saved: Supplier status and score candidate executed
scoreStatusExecution.failed: Execution failed; check raw evidence, state/score dictionaries, participants, confirmation, and revisions

matchConflict.warning: This records a review decision only and never changes the canonical match state or score.
matchConflict.reasonRequired: The reason must contain at least 3 characters
matchConflict.failed: Operation failed; check sources, mappings, dictionaries, or version

shadow.title: Sportmonks / Goalserve shadow comparison
shadow.selectSources: Select both the primary and shadow sources
shadow.loadFailed: Failed to load the shadow comparison report

versionConflict: This record was changed by another operator. Refresh and retry.

permission.scoreStatusExecute: Execute supplier status and score candidates

messages.failed: Operation failed. Check data, reason, or version.
